title: Christmas Animal Wooden Ornaments Bundle
description:
This is a digital bundle of Christmas animal wooden ornaments designs. You can use these files to create your own ornaments, decorations, gifts, and more. The files are vector graphics, so you can resize them without losing quality. Ideal for DIY crafters and designers. 
The bundle includes three types of digital files:
1. SVG File: This is a vector file that you can use with cutting machines like the Cricut and Silhouette. This is also the type of file you would need if you want to modify or edit the designs using software like Adobe Illustrator.
2. EPS File: This is another type of vector file that you can use with a wide range of software and cutting machines. It is a universally accepted vector format.
3. DFX File: This type of file is often used for CNC routing machines and laser cutting machines. It's also compatible with CAD software.
After your purchase, you will receive a ZIP file containing all three types of files. Please note, you will need to have the appropriate software to open and use these files.
As this is a digital product, no physical items will be shipped to you. You can download your files immediately after purchase. These files are for personal use only, and may not be shared or resold in any form. Enjoy your crafting!
